review_locator: PMID:16129412, Signaling by Kit protein-tyrosine kinase--the stem cell factor receptor; PMID:34167206, Regulation of Mast Cell Proliferation, Maturation and Function by Stem Cell Factor
primary_title: Structural basis for stem cell factor-KIT signaling and activation of class III receptor tyrosine kinases; Structural basis for activation of the receptor tyrosine kinase KIT by stem cell factor
decision_basis: The reviews identify KIT as the SCF receptor; the cited primary structural studies resolve SCF bound to KIT ectodomains and show ligand-driven KIT dimerization and activation-compatible assembly.
limitations_preserved: Preserve soluble versus membrane SCF, SCF dimerization, KIT ectodomain/dimer interface, and hematopoietic/mast-cell comparator limits; no CNS or SCI transfer.

review_locator: PMID:9371269, The molecular physiology of erythropoietin and the erythropoietin receptor; PMCID:PMC3134576, The Erythropoietin Receptor: Molecular Structure and Hematopoietic Signaling Pathways
primary_title: Efficiency of signalling through cytokine receptors depends critically on receptor orientation; Engineering a soluble extracellular erythropoietin receptor (EPObp) in Pichia pastoris to eliminate microheterogeneity, and its complex with erythropoietin
decision_basis: The reviews identify EPOR as the EPO receptor and describe ligand-dependent receptor orientation; the cited primary studies resolve the EPO-EPOR extracellular complex and link EPO binding geometry to receptor signaling and proliferation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve asymmetric EPO:EPOR dimer geometry and JAK2-dependent cytokine-receptor signaling; structural/hematopoietic comparator only, with no non-erythroid or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMID:34097561, The thrombopoietin receptor: revisiting the master regulator of platelet production; PMID:28408900, The Thrombopoietin Receptor: Structural Basis of Traffic and Activation by Ligand, Mutations, Agonists, and Mutated Calreticulin
primary_title: Structure of the thrombopoietin-MPL receptor complex is a blueprint for biasing hematopoiesis; Cryo-EM structure of the extracellular domain of murine Thrombopoietin Receptor in complex with Thrombopoietin
decision_basis: The reviews identify MPL/TPO-R as the cognate TPO receptor; the cited primary cryo-EM and biochemical studies resolve TPO engagement of MPL extracellular domains and the homodimeric receptor activation architecture.
limitations_preserved: Preserve TPO isoform/receptor species and homodimeric MPL geometry; platelet/megakaryocyte and hematopoietic context only, with no CNS or SCI transfer.

review_locator: PMID:25218975, Leptin and its receptors; PMCID:PMC5318964, The Leptin Receptor Complex: Heavier Than Expected?
primary_title: Structural insights into the mechanism of leptin receptor activation
decision_basis: The reviews identify LEPR/LepR as the leptin receptor and summarize its JAK/STAT signaling; the cited primary cryo-EM study resolves leptin-bound LepR assemblies and validates binding-interface mutations by STAT3 signaling assays.
limitations_preserved: Preserve LepR isoform and asymmetric leptin:LepR assembly, hypothalamic/energy-homeostasis context, and STAT3 readout boundaries; no SCI inference.
